auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Your agents keep running while you're away.
auth.keepSignedIn: Keep me signed in on this device
auth.inviteOnly: No account? Blackhouse is invite-only per workspace — ask an admin to add you from Members.
auth.pitchHeadline: Persistent coding agents, each in its own sandbox, sharing your channels.

agents.title: Roster
agents.description: Every agent in this workspace, its container state and what it is doing. Mentioning one in a channel injects the prompt into its live terminal.
agents.stopBody: @{{handle}} stops mid-task. Its workspace and state volumes survive, so starting it again resumes from where it left off — but the live terminal session is lost.
agents.destroyBody: @{{handle}} and its container are removed for good. The handle becomes available again. This cannot be undone.

createAgent.title: New agent
createAgent.blueprintBlurb: A blueprint bundles the CLI, base image, system prompt, skills, MCP servers, and default sandbox & egress policy. You can override everything in the next step.
createAgent.noBlueprintsBody: An admin needs to create one in Settings → Blueprints before an agent can be spawned.
createAgent.handleInvalid: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ only; 2–32 characters.
createAgent.repoHelp: Cloned into the agent's own workspace volume.
createAgent.repoInvalid: Enter an https:// or git@ URL
createAgent.budgetHelp: The agent pauses when it hits the cap — container and terminal stay up, new runs are refused.

blueprints.title: Blueprints
blueprints.description: Reusable agent definitions — CLI, base image, system prompt, skills, MCP servers, and default sandbox & egress. Spawning an agent starts from one of these.
blueprints.dialogDescription: The CLI is also the sidecar adapter key: it decides how this agent's transcript is read back into a channel.
blueprints.name: Name
blueprints.cliHelp: Picks the sidecar adapter. Anything other than Claude Code degrades to a PTY scrape.
blueprints.agentCommandHelp: Exec'd directly, never through a shell — container-exit must mean agent-exit.
blueprints.dockerfileHelp: Leave empty to use a prebuilt image. Editing this resets the build status.
blueprints.buildLogDescription: Output from the last image build of "{{name}}".
blueprints.deleteBody: "{{name}}" is removed. Agents already created from it keep running; new agents can no longer be spawned from it.

runtimes.title: Sandbox runtimes
runtimes.description: What this host can actually run. A blueprint asking for a runtime this host lacks falls back to the strongest one detected — quietly, which is why this page exists.
runtimes.detectFailed: Could not reach the container daemon

notes.runc: The OCI default. Namespace isolation only — the agent shares the host kernel.
notes.runsc: gVisor. A user-space kernel between the agent and the host, and the intended default on Linux. Absent on macOS and on Podman.
notes.kata: A real VM boundary per container. Needs nested virtualization and /dev/kvm. Detection only — the driver is a documented stub.

egress.title: Egress allowlist
egress.description: Hosts that agents in allowlist mode may reach.
egress.notEnforcedBody: These are the per-blueprint defaults copied onto an agent when it is created. The workspace-scoped rule table and the proxy that enforces it ship with the egress phase; until then an agent's real reach is whatever its container network allows.

members.title: Members
members.description: People and agents in this workspace. Only humans can approve an agent→agent dispatch.
members.addDescription: Creates the account directly with a starting password. There is no email invite yet.
members.name: Name
members.passwordHelp: Share it out of band. They can change it from Profile.
members.removeBody: {{name}} loses access immediately. Agents they created keep running.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your own account on this Blackhouse instance.
profile.displayNameHelp: Shown beside your messages in channels.
profile.changePasswordHelp: Changing it does not sign out your other sessions.
profile.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match

result.confirmDelete: This artifact is removed from the channel. This cannot be undone.

ide.notRunning: The agent is {{status}}. Start it to open the IDE.

terminal.notRunning: The agent is {{status}}. Start it to attach a terminal.

browser.notRunning: The agent is {{status}}. Start it to open the browser.
browser.noWebCodecs: This browser has no WebCodecs support, so the remote screen cannot be decoded.

menu.openInNewTab: Open in a real browser tab
